build.make: make -j2 (full build, ~585s on this VM) + make install

environment.cpu: AMD EPYC 9D25 126-Core Processor, 4 vCPU visible, ~1.5 effective CPU (shared VM)
environment.caveat: Shared VM (~1.5 effective CPU, ~7.7GB RAM shared, parallel processes) - numbers are noisy; run1 vs run2 differed by ~23% TPS with identical config. Treat baseline as order-of-magnitude regression detector, not absolute performance claim.

server_config.note: fsync/synchronous_commit off is a documented bench-only setting to measure CPU/query path, not durability; do not use in production.

pgbench_config.determinism: fixed scale=1, fixed -t 1000, single client/thread; pgbench data generation is deterministic in row count, transaction mix is the builtin script

hot_path: pgbench builtin TPC-B transaction: UPDATE pgbench_accounts / pgbench_tellers / pgbench_branches + SELECT abalance + INSERT pgbench_history, executed via postgres backend (parser/executor/storage) over Unix socket
